findings.message: CharacterCustomization properly extends RefCounted, keeping domain layer framework-agnostic. No Node dependencies.
Bounded design: clamped indices, fixed color palettes, static PERSIST_PATH. All choices are cosmetic-only as required.
Robust JSON persistence with error handling for missing files, parse errors, and type mismatches.
CharacterCustomizationPanel is compact and child-readable. Uses Polish labels, inherits translucent panel styling.
PlayerController integration supports GLB swap and material override for color tints. Preserves imported textures.
GameplayRuntime correctly loads customization on start_session and manages Postać button lifecycle.
7 comprehensive unit tests verify defaults, round-trip, clamping, corrupt JSON handling, and palette bounds.

summary: APPROVE. VS-022 implementation is complete, follows hexagonal architecture, and meets all acceptance criteria. Domain layer is clean, UI is child-appropriate, and persistence is robust with proper error handling.
